text:
devops_maya: quick flag 5 units H100 landed FRA -> eu-pool-B, depot report: 3 failing POST checks, AWBs 5544332211, 5544332212, 5544332213. This is in-flight for our Dedicated scaling next Tue. Need RMA & contingency routing.
vendor_alex: opened RMA and uploaded depot photos/logs. We're pulling 3 replacements from our EU reserve, ETA 48h if cleared; alternative is air from US reserve ~36h but higher surcharge.
peter-procure: Air ok if uplift < $6k/unit. Otherwise prefer splitting AWBs and routing via AMS crossdock to avoid extra fees.
sre_luca: Loss of 3 GPUs will cause batch queue backpressure and bump tail latency. Can we stage temporary nodes from eu-edge-3? Need ETA before we commit traffic shifts.
vendor_alex: Forwarder flagged 5544332211 for HS code mismatch and 5544332212 for missing receiver signature. They can reissue docs; reissue + air surcharge = $5.8k/unit for US->EU. Crossdock route adds ~18-24h but <$1.2k/unit.
tara-logs: Current tagging: eu-pool-B. If replacements come from US, we'll tag eu-temp-b and route through AMS crossdock to process customs. Pre-stage images and burn-in plan.
peter-procure: Approve emergency air uplift up to $5.5k/unit without finance escalation. If surcharge > $5.5k, default to crossdock. Vendor, will you absorb any portion?
vendor_alex: We can absorb up to $1.5k/unit. Propose 50/50 split on remainder.
ops-bot: Alert: eu-pool-B expected -3 GPUs from 2023-11-07T01:30Z until replacements attach.
sre_luca: If we go crossdock, request soft failover: route noncritical batch to us-west-autoscale group and set scheduler priority to avoid SLO noise.
devops_maya: Action items: 1) @vendor_alex confirm whether reissue is in-progress and final ETA in hours; 2) @tara-logs prep eu-temp-b tagging and onboarding checklist; 3) @peter-procure sign uplift or confirm crossdock. I'll notify CS and oncall.
peter-procure: If vendor covers customs fines and paperwork rework we prefer air. If vendor asks us to cover > $2k/unit for paperwork, crossdock.
vendor_alex: We'll cover paperwork rework fees; forwarder surcharge $5.8k/unit. Will propose split and add to RMA.
devops_maya: Get the split in writing and add SLA clause: replacements attached <=72h or we escalate credit.
vendor_alex: RMA-2023-0621 created: https://rma.vendor/2023/0621 1 docs uploaded. Provisional ETA 40h (pending receiver sign-off). Will attach replacement S/Ns and AWB reissue when available.
tara-logs: When S/Ns posted, please share in this exact format so infra automation can pre-stage:
```
replace_serials: [H100-EU22001, H100-EU22002, H100-EU22003]
awbs: [5544332211-reissued, 5544332212-reissued, 5544332213]
route: ams-crossdock -> eu-pool-B
```
sre_luca: If replacements are refurbished, require 8h burn-in and run perf canary. Failover plan ready.
ops-bot: RMA ticket updated: RMA-2023-0621 status "awaiting receiver sign-off".
peter-procure: I'll loop in finance only if vendor asks for >$2k/unit from us.
devops_maya: Ok team 3 keep updates in thread. Ping me if ETA slides beyond 48h or if RMA status changes to "customs hold". :thumbsup:
